# notice to air missions (NOTAM)

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:overlayTypeNOTAM`](gmeow-overlayTypeNOTAM.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/overlayTypeNOTAM>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [ABox role](../boxes/abox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A temporary, dynamic regulatory overlay issued to notify pilots of potential hazards or changes to aeronautical facilities, services, or procedures. Typically short-validity; modeled as a [`RegulatoryOverlay`](../classes/gmeow-RegulatoryOverlay.md) with brief [`duringInterval`](../properties/gmeow-duringInterval.md).
